jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst at CK Immobilier De Luxe 🇩🇿🇪🇦🇹🇷 will work part time in a remote capacity, focusing on identifying, assessing, and mitigating fraud and financial crime risks. Responsibilities include monitoring transactions and activities for suspicious patterns, conducting risk assessments, and preparing clear reports and recommendations for leadership. The role involves analyzing financial data, supporting the development and refinement of anti-fraud controls and procedures, and collaborating with internal stakeholders to improve risk management frameworks. The analyst will also assist in incident investigations, maintain accurate documentation, and stay informed about emerging fraud trends, regulatory expectations, and best practices.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret complex data sets to detect anomalies and potential fraud.
Candidates should possess expertise in risk analysis and a solid understanding of financial crime risk management frameworks.
Candidates should possess foundational knowledge of finance, including financial products, transactions, and basic accounting principles.
Candidates should possess effective communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Candidates should possess working knowledge of statistics and quantitative methods to support data-driven risk assessments.
Candidates should possess proficiency with spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and, ideally, basic SQL or similar query languages.
Candidates should possess strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and high ethical standards when handling sensitive information.
Relevant experience in fraud risk, compliance, or financial crime analysis, and a degree in finance, economics, statistics, criminology, or a related field are beneficial.
